title: FOIA request for USAF Campinas flight records answered by the CIA

tellings.quote: our team we filed a foyer and uh in in 2022, I think it was.

plain: James Fox says his team asked the US Air Force for flight records from Campinas, Brazil, dating from 1996, using FOIA, a US law that lets anyone request government records, and that the answer came back from the CIA, not the Air Force. Fox tells Michels this as something his own team did, "in 2022, I think it was." If true, it would suggest the CIA held or controlled records of American flights tied to that place and year.
